verdict.rationale: The evidence pack is entirely about Bitbucket Cloud's features (Jira integration, AI code review, CI/CD, security scanning) and general community sentiment; there is no mention of self-hosting options, supported operating systems, CPU architectures, or containerized deployment (e.g., Data Center Docker install).
